description: This file defines the PhotoView class, a custom Android ImageView that handles downloading, decoding, and displaying images from URLs, with features like caching, weak references to prevent memory leaks, and custom view behavior.

classes.name: PhotoView
classes.description: A custom ImageView for downloading and displaying images from URLs, with cache control and view lifecycle management.

methods.name: PhotoView
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the PhotoView with different attribute sets and contexts.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Reads custom style attributes, particularly the hide/show sibling resource ID.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Changes the visibility of the associated view referred by mThisView.

methods.name: clearImage
methods.description: Clears the current image drawable and makes the view visible.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with this ImageView.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Lifecycle callback that sets up weak references to sibling views when the view is attached.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Lifecycle callback that cleans up references and stops download threads when the view is detached.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Initiates image download if not already drawn and image URL is set.

methods.name: setHideView
methods.description: Sets the weak reference to a view that can be shown or hidden.

methods.name: setImageBitmap
methods.description: Sets the image using a Bitmap.

methods.name: setImageDrawable
methods.description: Sets the image Drawable and updates view visibility accordingly.

methods.name: setImageResource
methods.description: Sets a drawable resource as the image.

methods.name: setImageURI
methods.description: Sets the image using a URI.

methods.name: setImageURL
methods.description: Associates a URL with this ImageView and starts downloading the image, with cache control.

methods.name: setStatusDrawable
methods.description: Sets a Drawable when the ImageView is empty.

methods.name: setStatusResource
methods.description: Sets a resource drawable when the ImageView is empty.
